frame10.png.role_in_source: frame 10; left/reference image, exact crop of stereo Venus im2.ppm at (10,0)

frame11.png.role_in_source: frame 11; right/target image, exact crop of stereo Venus im6.ppm at (0,0)

flow10.flo.role_in_source: public optical flow GT from frame 10 to frame 11; horizontal rectified flow converted by disparity=-u in current image coordinates

preprocessing: None; files extracted directly from the official color two-frame and ground-truth-flow archives.

stereo_geometry.rectification_evidence: All 159600 GT flow vectors have v=0; pixel equality verified against crops of original rectified stereo views.
stereo_geometry.disparity_convention: x_left - x_right = -flow_u for the current images; negative and zero disparities are valid
stereo_geometry.camera_model: assumed pinhole, horizontal FoV 30 degrees, normalized baseline 1; see part_b.assumed_camera_model and saved camera.json
stereo_geometry.camera_assumption_reference: Basha, Moses, Kiryati (2013), Multi-view Scene Flow Estimation: A View Centered Variational Approach, IJCV 101, 6-21, section 4.1, DOI 10.1007/s11263-012-0542-7

known_gaps: No measured camera calibration has been identified; reconstruction uses explicitly cited assumptions and normalized units, not physical depth.
No occlusion ground-truth mask is provided for the cropped flow pair; consistency masks are reliability estimates.
Usage and redistribution terms were not verified during preparation.
